name: Miko Mama
source:
There is a small shrine. Jun returns to his home for the first time in six years after Shinto priest training. Kimie, his mother, Mari, his older sister, and Yukiko, his aunt, welcome him. Jun soon gets excited sexually when he sees these three women in Miko uniforms. Will he be able to keep his urges under control?
